Senses.PreferredTarget: three people attest that a turtle has become a soft-shelled turtle
AlternateTargets: three witnesses can certify a turtle into a soft-shelled turtle
Senses.Note: The second animal is the soft-shelled turtle. One record names Xianglin as the answerer; another names Dasui.

Occurrences.Kwic: 法無多子，正眼瞎驢滅。驀拈拄杖曰：妙嚴突出拄杖，三人證龜成鼈。以拄杖卓一卓曰：拄杖子，善甄別。硬却脊梁，莫教
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X82/X82n1571.xml). Complete Five Lamps (Vols. 34–120) (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)). Speaker: Liangshan Kuoan Ze.

Occurrences.Kwic: 何是室內一盌鐙？師曰：三人證龜成鼈。瑞巖慍云：三人證龜成
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1297.xml). Grove of the Mirror of the School (宗鑑法林). Speaker: Xianglin Chengyuan.

Occurrences.Kwic: 踏上頭關。舉。僧問香林。如何是室內一盞燈。林云。三人證龜成鼈。皎皎清光遍界莫藏。聲拋不出色豈能彰。直下斬釘截
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T47/T47n1997.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Yuanwu Foguo. Exact actor: Xianglin Chengyuan gives the inherited answer; Yuanwu Keqin raises the case and comments on it.

Occurrences.Kwic: 獨耀今古者麼？舉：僧問大隨：如何是室中燈？隨云：三人證龜成鼈。師云：譬如暗中寶，無燈不可見；佛法無人說，雖慧
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X67/X67n1303.xml). Elder Linquan’s Commentary and Chanted Remarks on Master Touzi Qing’s Verses on Ancient Cases: Empty Valley Collection. Exact actor: this record names Dasui Fazhen as the answerer; Linquan Conglun raises and comments on it.

Senses.Explanation: ‘Three people attest that a turtle has become a soft-shelled turtle’ makes repeated testimony produce an absurd change of identity. Liangshan Kuoan Ze applies it to the assembly’s treatment of his staff. The records disagree about the room-lamp answer. One names Xianglin Chengyuan, and Yuanwu Keqin later raises that version. Linquan Conglun’s record names Dasui Fazhen, then explains that a treasure in darkness cannot be seen without a lamp. Both named attributions are therefore shown.
